title: 1945 Prairie: the Armour-Corwith corner house stands
items: The corner house at 1945 Prairie Avenue, at 20th Street, is no longer a plain draft block: two storeys of brick over a high basement under a slated mansard with a dormer over every window, a canted bay at the north end of the front, the door over a tall straight stoop, round-headed windows on the principal floor, the corner cut on a slant toward 20th Street with a bay on that side, and an iron fence along the walk. It is built from the Chicago Tribune's 1928 'Famous Homes' photograph.
Still to come: the taller roof over the corner, the north bay's own curved roof and the arched doorway the photograph shows.
